metadata.title: Clicked like I lost my mind and Valorant said ‘Here’s 2 kills, try not to crash’
metadata.description:
Me: panicking and clicking like a maniac
Enemies: probably uninstalling in disbelief
Valorant just handed me 2 kills like it’s a glitch
If your aim’s a mystery but kills still drop, you get me

Tap if your aim’s a walking disaster but kills still happen!

#valorant #luckykills #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
